name: Skruen - Rennebu
description:
Works very well in afternoon with cliffs below, nice for evening thermal soaring, hike and fly. Reliable with valley breeze from NW/N, the wind turns straight up this hillside. Normally very smooth and consistent. Convergence possible.

Many take-off options around the top where the trail emerges, rather than the true summit. Many landing options in the valley.
Best to park by the toll station, (62°52'56.5"N 9°50'40.4"E) space for one or two cars, walk along the road until you meet the path via Pilgrimsleden, then it is a quite steep but only 1.5km.
More parking space at the Joker shop nearby in Voll.
